whyItMatters: yaml.load() without a SafeLoader can construct arbitrary Python objects from a malicious document, which is remote code execution when the sender is untrusted.
actions: Use yaml.safe_load() for every document from an untrusted sender.
If full YAML is required, pass Loader=yaml.SafeLoader explicitly and document why.
Re-run a SAST scan after the fix and confirm DPK-SAST-012 is no longer observed.
verification: The finding disappears on rescan and no unsafe yaml.load( call remains in the changed files.
